summary: Closure review of a preregistered paired confirmatory experiment (N=600 pairs) comparing single‑shot LLM generation and a generate→validate→repair pipeline under shared_initial_candidate semantics. The run and analysis appear archived and self‑consistent; the manuscript has addressed the major analytic and interpretive issues (explicit shared_initial_candidate semantics, reporting of the unexecuted 100‑case validator audit, master‑prompt locator/SHA‑256, sampling‑semantics note). One substantive required revision from the prior terminal review remains unresolved: the References must be converted into a standard IEEE numbered bibliography using the archived, verified bibliographic metadata; several other bibliographic/formatting cleanups are also needed. After those bibliographic fixes are applied the paper should be finalisable.
critical_issues: References are not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full, consistently formatted metadata tied to the in‑text numeric citations. The archived terminal_bibliographic_records provide the verified metadata; the manuscript must publish them in IEEE numbered reference format so each in‑text numeric marker maps unambiguously to a full reference entry.
required_revisions: Replace the manuscript References section with a standard IEEE numbered bibliography using the archived terminal_bibliographic_records and any other verified metadata in the evidence bundle. Ensure each in‑text numeric citation (e.g., [1], [2], ...) corresponds exactly to a numbered reference entry containing full author list, title, venue (or repository label such as 'arXiv preprint'), year, and DOI/URL where available.

Resolve any ambiguous or placeholder venue text in cited records by substituting the verified venue/repository names from the archived bibliographic records; if venue metadata genuinely does not exist, label the entry clearly (e.g., 'arXiv preprint') and include full author/title/year metadata.

After inserting the IEEE‑style reference list, confirm in the manuscript that every in‑text citation number matches the intended reference (no orphaned numeric citations or unreferenced bibliography entries).
optional_revisions: If space allows (within the five‑page limit), add a brief table mapping generation semantics (shared_initial_candidate vs independent per‑condition draws) to the estimand each semantics identifies to aid reader design decisions.

If any archived validator‑audit artifacts exist (even partial), consider a short one‑paragraph appendix summarizing them; otherwise keep the clear statement that the preregistered 100‑case validator audit was not executed and therefore validator sensitivity remains unassessed.

Optionally include a very short illustrative paired example (one task) showing the shared_initial_candidate reuse and the validator trace excerpt, or else cite the exact archived trace file and its hash in the Disclosure for readers to inspect.
